concept.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
concept.shortdesc: Learn how multi-factor authentication protects your account even if your password is stolen.

conbody.p: Multi-factor authentication is an extra sign-in step for added security, so even if someone steals your password they can't sign in without your second device.

section.title: How Duo Protects University Systems
section.p: Duo adds a second step to NC State services like MyPack Portal and WolfWare.
You confirm by approving a push notification, entering a code from the app, or entering a code that is sent to you via text.
section.xref: For details, see Duo authentication methods.

section.title: Why Staff Are Required to Use It
section.p: All NC State employees are required to use Duo because they have access to more sensitive data and systems.
